\pdfvariable compresslevel=0
\pdfvariable objcompresslevel=0
\documentclass[paper={a5paper},maintitle={Chapter Mark Test}]{ulsbs-songbook}

% Count geometry builds without depending on how the cache is implemented.
\makeatletter
\let\ulsbsTestBuildMark\ulsbs@ccm@build
\renewcommand*\ulsbs@ccm@build{\typeout{ULSBS-TEST-MARK-BUILD}\ulsbsTestBuildMark}
\makeatother

\begin{document}
\ulUseChapterColors{true}
\ulChapterCornerMarkWidth=4bp
\ulChapterCornerMarkLength=17bp
\makeatletter\def\ulsbs@currentchaptercolor{red}\makeatother
Solid right.\newpage
\makeatletter\def\ulsbs@currentchaptercolor{blue}\makeatother
Solid left.\newpage
% Use two gaps for the geometry assertions, independent of the style default.
\ulChapterCornerMarkDashCount=2
\ulChapterCornerMarkDashed{true}
Dashed right.\newpage
Dashed left.\newpage
\ulChapterCornerMarkLength=5bp
Short dashed right.\newpage
\ulChapterCornerMarkDashCount=1
Short dashed left.\newpage
\ulChapterCornerMarkLength=1bp
Only the elbow.\newpage
\ulUseChapterColors{false}
No marks.
